body:
You're right, the current official release offers export to JXL, but when I try it, an error message "unable to save file... " appears. Then the job hangs and if I cancel it, the application crashes.

The reason, as far as I understand, is that the cjxl encoder bundled in ART-imageio looks for a library (libz) in an hardcoded path `/opt/local/lib`, which is not present on my machine (again, probably because it's Macports specific).

`bundle_ART.py`, which is what I ultimately use, assumes a Macports system, and it must also be executed within the sequence of steps of this repo's CI/CD (including patching and installing a local GTK+3). But for me, it also needed a couple of wrapper scripts to work around other issues with library dependencies which were not included or the wrong versions were. 

But this is beyond of the scope this issue.
